defs.def: afraid; feeling fear 惊吓的；受惊的；害怕的

ex.s: He had   43   to coax（哄）the dog to him but, frightened, it had   44  .
ex.t: 他曾试图哄那只小狗过来，但它受到惊吓，____44____跑了。

ex.s: When the gorillas and I frightened each other, I was just glad to find    68   (they) alive.
ex.t: 当大猩猩和我互相吓到对方时，我只为找到它们____68____（they）活着而感到庆幸。

ex.s: I was frightened at the sight of the test paper.
It made people frightened of sharks, especially of the great white shark.
ex.t: 这让人们对鲨鱼感到恐惧，尤其是大白鲨。

ex.s: [THE POWER of GOOD “The British Schindler”: the life of Nicholas Winton] It is August 1939, and a group of frightened children are boarding a train at Prague's Wilson Station.
ex.t: 【善良的力量　“英国辛德勒”：尼古拉斯·温顿的生平】1939年8月，一群受惊的孩子正在布拉格的威尔逊车站登上火车。

ex.s: I was so frightened that I just froze.
I spent much of the time when I was there feeling frightened and more than a little bored!
ex.t: 我在那里的那段时光，大多感到害怕，而且远不止一点点无聊！
